content: Řeɛdawat n Cawul ḍidd i Dawud
Umi ikemmeř Dawud řhard ak-d Cawul, imsar, aqa řeɛmar n Yunatan iqqen ɣar Dawud, u Yunatan ittexs Dawud am řeɛmar nnes.
Cawul iksi ɣares Dawud deg wass nni u war t ijji ɛad ad iɛqeb ɣar taddart n babas.
Yunatan igga ijj n řɛahd ak-d Dawud, minzi netta ittexs i-t am yixef nnes.
Yunatan ikkes aseřham nnes i tuɣa yarḍ, iwca i-t i Dawud, uřa d arruḍ nnes, uca ɛawed ssif nnes d řqews nnes d webyas nnes i řesnaḥ.
Dawud iffeɣ ɣar umenɣi mani ma issekk i-t Cawul. Tuɣa abrid nnes mliḥ ařami t yarra Cawul x iɛeskariyyen nnes. Tuɣa Dawud d lemliḥ di tiṭṭawin n marra řgens uřa di tiṭṭawin n imsexxaren n Cawul.

Xmi dd-usin umi yareggʷeḥ Dawud awarni i řeɣřeb x Ifilisṭiniyyen, imsar, aqa ffɣent-i-dd temɣarin zi marra tineddam n Israil i umsagar ak-d Cawul uca ɣennjent u ceḍḥent s ibendiren, s řefraḥet u s řgambriyat s třata n ifiřan.
Timɣarin arrint meẓri nsent, ɣennjent s nnubtat, nnant: “Cawul iɣřeb x řuřuf nnes, maca Dawud x ɛecra n řuřuf nnes!”
Cawul iffugem aṭṭas. Tuɣa d man aya d řɛib di tiṭṭawin nnes, inna: “Wcint i Dawud ɛecra n řuřuf, maca wcint ayi mɣir řuřuf. Maca teqqim as mɣir tgelda waha?”
Zeg wass nni sennej ibda Cawul iḥeṭṭa Dawud.

Tiwecca nnes imsar, aqa iwḍa-dd ɛawed řaryaḥ d aɛeffan n AREBBI x Cawul, u idweř ittekk x uzeǧif di taddart nnes, am tuɣa ittirar Dawud am wussan nneɣni s ufus nnes x řgambri. Cawul tuɣa ɣares lansa deg ufus.
Cawul inḍar lansa, inna: “Necc ad řeqfeɣ Dawud u ad t semmareɣ ɣar řḥiḍ.” Izemmar Dawud ad as ixnes tnayen n twařawin.
Tuɣa Cawul itteggʷed zi Dawud, minzi SIDI tuɣa-t ak-d Dawud, maca tuɣa ismeḥ di Cawul.
S uyenni issiggʷej Cawul Dawud x yixef nnes, igga i-t d ameqqran x wařef. Netta itteffeɣ u ittareggʷaḥ zzat i wudem n řgens.
Tuɣa Dawud ifřeḥ di marra ibriden nnes u SIDI tuɣa-t akides.
Umi iẓra Cawul, aqa Dawud ifřeḥ, tuɣa netta itteggʷed zzat i wudem nnes.
Maca marra Israil d Yahuda ttexsen Dawud, minzi netta itteffeɣ u ittareggʷaḥ zzat i wudem nsen.

Cawul inna i Dawud: “Xzar, necc ad ac wceɣ Mirab, yeǧi tameqqrant qaɛ, d tamɣart. Mɣir iři d ijj n uḍeggʷař imḥeḍ deg umenɣi i necc u mneɣ imenɣan n SIDI.” Inna Cawul ak-d yixef nnes: “Ḥima war ittiři ufus inu ḍidd nnes, maca afus n Ifilisṭiniyyen ad yiři ḍidd nnes.”
Inna Dawud i Cawul: “Min ɛniɣ necc d min teɛna tudart inu d min teɛna řaǧ n baba di Israil, aqa necc ad dewřeɣ d aḍeggʷař n ujeǧid?”
Umi dd-tiweḍ řweqt i di i ɣa temmewc Mirab, yeǧis n Cawul, d tamɣart i Dawud, imsar, aqa temmewc nettat d tamɣart i Ɛadriyil zi Maḥula.
Mixal, yeǧis n Cawul, tuɣa tᵉttexs Dawud. Xebbaren as t i Cawul u tuɣa aya d ict n tmesřact tecna di tiṭṭawin nnes.
Inna Cawul: “Necc ad as tt wceɣ, ḥima ad as idweř d řfex u ḥima ad yiři ufus n Ifilisṭiniyyen ḍidd nnes.” Inna Cawul i Dawud: “Ass-a tzemmared ad tdewřed d aḍeggʷař inu s tenni d wiss tnayen.”
Yumur Cawul i imsexxaren nnes: “Siweř ak-d Dawud di tnuffra, ini: ‘Aqa cek tusid-dd i ujeǧid x řxaḍar u marra imsexxaren ttexsen cek. Xenni dweř řexxu d aḍeggʷař n ujeǧid.’”
Ssiwřen imsexxaren n Cawul awařen-a deg imezzuɣen n Dawud. Xenni inna Dawud: “Ma d tamesřact tehwen di tiṭṭawin nwem ad idweř ijj d aḍeggʷař n ujeǧid? Ma war ǧiɣ d ijj n weryaz d amezřuḍ d amuqřiř?”
Imsexxaren n Cawul ḥajan as t, nnan: “Issiweř Dawud awařen-a.”

Xenni inna Cawul: “Ammu i ɣa tinim i Dawud: ‘Ajeǧid war d as teɛjib ṣṣadaq, maca iɛjeb as mya n řeɛdařeyyat n Ifilisṭiniyyen, ḥima ad intaqem zi řɛedyan n ujeǧid.” Tuɣa Cawul ittxarraṣ ad ineɣ Dawud s ufus n Ifilisṭiniyyen.
Ixeddamen nnes ɛawden awařen-a i Dawud. Xenni tuɣa aya d ict n tmesřact tecna di tiṭṭawin n Dawud, ḥima ad idweř d aḍeggʷar n ujeǧid. Řmijař n wussan ittwaggen tuɣa ɛad war ɛdun.

Xenni ikkar Dawud. Netta d yeryazen nnes ṭṭfen abrid, uca iwta netta mitayen n yeryazen n Ifilisṭiniyyen. Yiwi-dd Dawud řeɛdařeyyat nsen u s uya sedden nitni qaɛ řqedd-a i ujeǧid, ḥima ad idweř d aḍeggʷař n ujeǧid. Xenni iwca as Cawul yeǧis Mixal d tamɣart.
Cawul iẓra u issen, aqa SIDI tuɣa-t ak-d Dawud, u Mixal, yeǧis n Cawul, tuɣa tᵉttexs i-t.
Idweř Cawul iggʷed ɛad ktar zi Dawud uca Cawul idweř d řeɛdu n Dawud marra ussan n tudart nnes.
Umi dd-ffɣen řḥukkam n Ifilisṭiniyyen, imsar, meřmi ma ffɣen tuɣa Dawud yarenni mahu di wefřaḥ nnes x marra imsexxaren n Cawul, ařami idweř isem nnes icennɛen ař ṭṭarf.

footnotes.text: aḍeggʷař- ixs ad yini aqa Cawul iwaɛd i Dawud belli wanita ad idweř d ‘mmis nnes’ s řemrac ak-d yessis.
